intro.title: Build PII masking utility for logs
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a PII (Personally Identifiable Information) masking utility for logs in Node.js. This tool will help protect sensitive data like email addresses and phone numbers by replacing them with masked versions in log output. You'll learn to use JavaScript regular expressions to identify patterns of PII within strings. The core programming concepts involve string manipulation and pattern matching to ensure logs are secure and compliant with privacy standards.
intro.usecase: This PII masking utility is essential for any Node.js application handling sensitive user data in logs, such as customer support dashboards, financial transaction systems, or healthcare portals. For example, when a user submits a form with personal details, developers must ensure that logs—visible in admin panels or debugging tools—automatically mask fields like emails, phone numbers, or social security numbers. This pattern prevents accidental exposure in compliance audits or error monitoring services, safeguarding privacy while maintaining debuggability in production environments.
